# Todo layout test font

`Cantarell-Regular.ttf` is an unmodified test-only font from RunenUI
`712d9240052cde9dd2ece2516d28f599d3f2465d`,
`crates/runenui_text/tests/fixtures/Cantarell-Regular.ttf`.
Its SIL Open Font License 1.1 notice is retained in `Cantarell-Regular.OFL.txt`.

The layout tests register this font explicitly so placeholder publication does
not depend on host-installed fonts. Production font selection is unchanged.
